job.job_description:
Job Description
We are looking for a GenAI + Databricks Engineer with hands-on experience in Data Engineering and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should have expertise in building scalable data pipelines, working with Databricks, Python, and cloud platforms, while enabling AI/LLM-based use cases for business applications.
Roles Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks.
Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows for structured and unstructured data.
Develop and deploy Generative AI solutions using LLMs.
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures and vector databases.
Work with large-scale datasets using Spark and PySpark.
Integrate AI solutions with cloud services and enterprise applications.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data and AI workloads.
Ensure data quality, governance, and security standards.
Mandatory Skills
2-5 years of experience in Data Engineering and/or GenAI
